name: Vikas Chaudhary
text: Excellent dry cleaning setup for all types of clothes They use German organic chemicals and softeners for maximum cleaning and and fabric care. I had given blankets, suits and got it cleaned in 12 hours. Highly recommended.

name: Alok pratap singh
text: Very nice optimized automated cleaning as per fabric requirements, rejuvenate the fabric Nice and clean hygienic packing Must try one of the best in Gorakhpur for all kinds of laundry service, shoe cleaning, and car cleaning.

name: Ayush Vaishnav
text: I live in Canada, came back here after a year, and when I show the conditions of my sofa I was a mess and a friend of mine told me about Mycleaners and I'm amazed they really made me happy with their work.

name: Adarsh Singh
text: Excellent and quick drycleaning service provided by them. My old blazer was stained with food items, but they made it look brand new within 24 hours Awesome experience,I am looking forward to avail other services provided by them.
